meta.description: Context tool command registry. Agents may extend by adding commands, kits, or requests.

index.description: List context files with sizes, dates, and staleness indicators

search.description: Wedge-style term search across context with expansion hints

trust.description: Report confidence levels and known stale regions

summarize.description: Generate or retrieve agent-maintained summary at specified depth

forgive.description: Acknowledge drift, reset baseline without shame. Maintains .forgiveness-log.json

honor.description: Mark something as learned-from, archive to honored/ with extracted lessons

contract.description: Generate lean agent contracts to replace bloated system prompts

stake.description: Map decisions to responsibility concerns. Explicit ethics without theater.

locate.description: Identity resolution for multi-project context management. Determines git root, project location, and manages project switching.

start.description: Deterministic entry point. Shows current work, recent history, top todos without file exploration.

todos.description: Structured TODO management with progress tracking, depth control, and auto-history updates.

state.description: Query project state with tag/status/confidence filters. Works with state.json.

decision.description: Query architectural decisions with tag/status/confidence filters. Wedge-based exploration of decisions.json.

find.description: Find files/symbols in codebase without filesystem exploration.

finish.description: Complete iteration and prepare for handoff. Records work, updates history, optionally archives.

continue.description: Resume work after interruption without finishing iteration. Marks pause in history.

fear.description: Autonomous breakout from recursive loops via project rotation. Snapshots state, rotates context, enables regrounding with fresh perspective.

codebase.description: Query code location map from codebase.json with tag/type filters. Find files/patterns without filesystem exploration.

plan.description: Command discovery funnel. Shows available planning commands grouped by purpose. Guides wedge workflow.

pack.description: Create portable handoff archive of current context for migration between machines.

unpack.description: Restore context from handoff archive. Supports --merge and --force options.

topic.description: Progressive context expansion via wedge-shaped search. Topics are expandable detail nodes with save-point semantics.

phase.description: Phase transition model (PRAY cycle): Pause/Parse, Rejoin, Adapt, Yield. Internal state tracking for ctx as mini-OS.

narrative.description: History as story, not archive. Fiscal year scope with chapters capturing contribution, effectiveness, lessons, durability.
